nodes.title: Reference board · resolution
widgets_values:
# H3 resolution reference · 16:9 / multiple 32

Selector MP is an AREA parameter (1024×1024 basis), not exact millions of pixels.

| Selector | Output (W×H) | Actual px | Note |
|---:|---|---:|---|
| 0.7 | 1152×640 | 737,280 | low-cost preview |
| **0.9** | **1280×736** | **942,080** | THIS tested PRO6000 canvas |
| 1.0 | 1376×768 | 1,056,768 | near 768p |
| 1.2 | 1504×832 | 1,251,328 | high-detail comparison |
| 1.5 | 1664×928 | 1,544,192 | costly / experimental |

**Official H3-Base:** default SHORT EDGE = 768 px.
**Common 16:9 H3-Base canvas:** **1344×768** (1,032,192 px). Enter width and height explicitly if exact 1344×768 is needed. H3-Regenerate-2K is a separate stage, not automatically active here.

**This workflow:** selector 0.9 => 1280×736, fps 24. Duration slider 7s is snapped to 17n+5 frames; 7s input currently yields 175 frames (~7.29s).

10+ sec shots: evaluate identity/motion over the WHOLE clip. Costs climb faster than raw pixels; see project run notes.

Official: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3

nodes.title: Reference board · H3 workflow controls
widgets_values:
# Operational modes
## Native original 20-step (default)
- Acceleration Boolean OFF; all Power LoRA rows OFF
- `res_multistep` / `beta` / 20 steps. Default model and conditions remain as uploaded.
## LightX2V 8-step (unverified)
- Enable the matching LightX2V v1.1 Ref2VA row in Power LoRA Loader, strength 1.0
- Set Acceleration Boolean ON; the Boolean switches MODEL through shift 12/3, Euler sampler, and simple 8-step scheduler
- Both the LoRA row and acceleration mode must be enabled together; the Boolean does NOT automatically toggle the LoRA row.
- No Larry/PDD/10Eros/Spectrum stacking. Verify first GPU MP4 before treating 8-step as production.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1] 2D-animated cinematic Japanese urban romance, with refined anime feature-film lighting, delicate hand-drawn contours, softly layered cel shading, atmospheric depth and luminous twilight colors.

Inside a modern Japanese electric train traveling along an elevated railway through a beautiful fictional metropolis at dusk. The carriage features an exceptionally wide panoramic side window, elegant yet believable passenger seating, and a quiet, inviting everyday atmosphere.

Galleon, a single adult-appearing anime woman, sits comfortably beside the panoramic window. Preserve her distinctive mature facial proportions, long dark-brown hair and bangs, two very long upright animal ears, large curved horns extending from the sides of her head, and pointed side ears. Her clothing follows the selected Japanese sailor-uniform reference exactly, without introducing elements from her original fantasy costume.

The camera observes her from a slightly frontal three-quarter angle at approximately seated eye level. A medium shot includes her head, both complete upright ears, both horns, upper body, relaxed arms, and the surrounding seat. The window and distant city remain clearly visible beside and behind her.

At the beginning, Galleon is already seated, her hips supported by the seat, shoulders relaxed, hands resting naturally, and eyes gently closed. Her head is slightly oriented toward the window.

As the train glides forward, the city outside moves gradually across the glass. Galleon makes one small, unhurried adjustment of her head toward the window and settles into a comfortable resting position. Her long hair tips and sailor-uniform fabric respond subtly to the gentle motion of the train, with restrained inertia and natural damping.

Beyond the window, layered mid-rise buildings and distant towers stretch across an expansive elevated cityscape. The sky is filled with immense, softly illuminated blue-violet and purple-gray clouds. Scattered amber lights begin to glow among the buildings. Cool twilight from the window gently illuminates Galleon's face, hair, horns and clothing, balanced by subtle warm illumination from the carriage.

The entire image shares one coherent anime rendering system: simplified but richly layered architectural surfaces, carefully controlled reflections on the glass, luminous atmospheric perspective, clean shadow shapes and delicate color transitions. The scene feels bright, peaceful, romantic and slightly dreamlike, without becoming photorealistic, cyberpunk or dominated by golden sunset colors.

Camera: static, steady framing throughout the shot. The character remains anchored within the carriage while the moving exterior establishes a subtle sense of travel. No camera orbit or sudden reframing.

At the end, Galleon remains comfortably seated with her eyes closed, her head gently inclined toward the panoramic window. The moving city and luminous twilight sky remain visible, preserving a natural visual connection to the following wider city-view shot. Her characteristic ears and horns remain completely within the frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft continuous electric-train rolling ambience, a restrained low mechanical hum, and faint carriage vibrations. No dialogue or singing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

nodes.title: LoRA asset board · planned usage
widgets_values:
# Creative LoRA library — single Power LoRA Loader
- Row 1: optional H3-compatible style/character/motion LoRA. It starts empty and disabled. Select an actual model file before enabling.
- Row 2: optional LightX2V **Ref2VA** 8-step LoRA, disabled by default.
- Each row has its own enable switch and strength; add more creative rows in the SAME node rather than creating another loader.
- Acceleration mode is the neighboring Boolean and also controls sampler/scheduler/shifts. Do not combine unrelated distill LoRAs.
- LoRA weights, training data and good generation examples should be stored outside temporary Vast instances.

nodes.title: Seed / run notes · rgthree + history
widgets_values:
# Seed tracking
- The working native `RandomNoise` seed stays as provided. `rgthree Seed` can be connected to the converted noise seed input after testing on actual ComfyUI.
- `rgthree Seed`: randomize, fix, use last queued seed.
- Existing GitHub `comfyui_seed_finder` searches actual `/history` for output filename and execution seed. Destroyed instance history is not guaranteed to survive.
- Exact reproducibility also requires same model, LoRA, prompt, references, sampler, resolution and frames.

nodes.title: Cloud rental · reuse checklist
widgets_values:
# Next Vast rental · public deployment repository
Use the previously working Vast ComfyUI template, adapting paths to the new instance.
```
cd /workspace
# once per new instance: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Kwaner-ANTI/AIGC-C.W.P.git
cd AIGC-C.W.P
export AIW_COMFY_DIR=/workspace/ComfyUI
export AIW_PYTHON=/venv/main/bin/python
export AIW_ASSETS_ROOT=/workspace/aiworkbench-assets
bash bootstrap.sh h3-int8-int8
bash bootstrap.sh h3-audio
bash bootstrap.sh h3-lightx2v-ref2va8  # optional pending GPU test
```
Upload reference images to instance; workflow stores paths, not image bytes. Public repo means no GitHub token needed for clone. Do not commit API tokens, SSH keys or authentication data. The Vast instance must use its existing ComfyUI service.
